text_block_list.text: The spring Tenno Sho has arrived.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Everyone has been eager for the big
BNW
rematch at the new venue, Hanshin
Racecourse,
but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Really?! You just had to get yourself
hurt, huh?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
But don't worry! Since I can't run, I'll
cheer you
two on with my whole being
instead!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Ugh, don't. Just use a quarter of your
being so
you don't destroy the eardrums
of everyone
around you.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Hello, Taishin. It appears we're in for
another
head-to-head battle today.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I created my winning equation through
sheer
determination and hard work...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I'll show you just how effective it is
today!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
